_README: UAT run manifest. Copy this file to the NEW run's directory, fill every field,
then gate the run on it:  npx tsx scripts/uat/run-preflight.ts <path-to-this-file>
Every angle-bracket value below is a placeholder and is REJECTED by the preflight.
That is deliberate: UAT-HF-20260811-01 executed all 456 steps and could never be
signed off, because no accountable owner had been assigned (DEF-001).
Never edit a closed run. A retest gets a new runId and a new directory.
buildSha: <full or short git SHA of the exact commit under test>
target: <https://... or the environment name under test>

owners.business: <name — re-rates severity and accepts residual risk at sign-off>
owners.operations: <name — owns environment, flags and the deploy under test>
owners.accessibility: <name — accepts a11y findings and any expiry attached to them>
owners.networkFault: <name — authorises fault injection and confirms blast radius>
owners.dataReset: <name — owns the controlled data lanes and their cleanup>
owners.privacy: <name — approves what member data may be seen, revealed and captured>

oracles.source: <where it comes from — MUST be independent of the system under test>

fixtures.description: <what it is and which scenario creates it>

flags._comment: Record the feature-flag state the run executes against. Empty object is valid; absent is not.

_comment: Declare true/false honestly. Each one silently Blocked steps in UAT-HF-20260811-01,
and none of those could be unblocked by any product fix.
Declaring a scenario that needs a capability set to false is a preflight FAILURE.
